candidates.name: Official searches (PG12)
verified_facts: HM Land Registry PG12 explains the purpose and effect of official search applications.
The collection was last updated 28 July 2025.
semantic_limits: Official-search priority and registry effects are legal/registration controls, not terrain-height measurements.

candidates.name: Practice guide 12: official searches
verified_facts: An OS2 official search with priority can apply to part of a registered title or pending first-registration application where the disposition is for value.
PG12 states that a plan failing the stated criteria can cause the application to be cancelled.
semantic_limits: Registry plan-acceptance criteria do not establish centimetric parcel geometry or vertical accuracy.

candidates.name: Developing estates: estate boundary approval (PG41s1)
verified_facts: Estate boundary approval compares a developer's first site survey with the extent of the registered title.
The service is intended to identify differences between registered title boundaries and physical estate boundaries early.
semantic_limits: This comparison service is not evidence that an ordinary INSPIRE polygon is an exact legal boundary.

candidates.name: Estate boundary approval detailed guidance
verified_facts: The service compares the first site survey with the registered-title extent before layout design.
HM Land Registry states that physical external-boundary differences can be identified at the earliest opportunity and that decisions can then use the same external boundaries.
semantic_limits: A detected agreement between survey and registered extent remains horizontal title evidence, separate from LiDAR elevation uncertainty.

candidates.name: Developing estates: estate plan approval (PG41s2)
verified_facts: HM Land Registry provides an estate plan approval service for developing estates.
The service is intended to simplify later official copies, official searches and registrations.
semantic_limits: Estate-plan approval is a registration workflow control and does not certify terrain elevation values.

candidates.name: Estate plan approval detailed guidance
verified_facts: HM Land Registry states that estate plan approval does not confirm that planning permission has been sought or obtained.
The detailed plan and surveying requirements are referenced separately in PG41 supplement 5.
semantic_limits: Registry approval must not be interpreted as planning approval, construction viability or terrain-measurement certification.

candidates.name: Approval of draft transfers and leases (PG41s3)
verified_facts: PG41 supplement 3 provides guidance for approval of draft transfers and leases on developing estates.
The guide was last updated 2 March 2026.
semantic_limits: Draft-document approval does not establish exact terrain or boundary coordinates for this slot.

candidates.name: Draft transfers and leases detailed guidance
verified_facts: Plans attached to draft transfers should be copies of or extracts from the latest approved estate plan.
The plan should show true scale, a north point and relevant colours; intricate boundaries may require a larger-scale or inset plan.
semantic_limits: An approved estate-plan extract is still registration-plan evidence, not a replacement for the exact HMLR polygon and raster sampling chain.

candidates.name: Developing estates: plot sales, transfers and leases (PG41s4)
verified_facts: PG41 supplement 4 contains guidance for purchasers of plots on new developments and their legal advisers.
The guide covers proof that a plot is within the developer's title and official-search issues.
semantic_limits: Plot-sale registry evidence does not independently validate elevation or exact legal-boundary coordinates.

candidates.name: Plot sales transfers and leases detailed guidance
verified_facts: The guide explains how a purchaser can satisfy themselves that a plot and its rights fall within the developer's title.
It separately addresses adverse register entries and official copies/searches.
semantic_limits: Title inclusion and register-search controls are not vertical terrain measurements.

candidates.name: Official Searches and Official Copies practice-guide collection
verified_facts: The collection identifies PG10, PG11 and PG12 as the relevant official-search/copy guides.
The collection lists PG10 as updated 20 July 2026 and PG12 as updated 28 July 2025.
semantic_limits: A guide index provides authority and freshness context only; it does not supply parcel geometry or elevation.

candidates.name: Land registration practice-guide collection
verified_facts: The collection lists current HM Land Registry plan and developing-estate practice guides.
It records PG40 supplements 3 and 4 as updated 1 June 2026, PG40 supplement 5 as updated 13 July 2026 and PG41 supplement 3 as updated 2 March 2026.
semantic_limits: Guide publication freshness is lineage context and not measurement evidence.

candidates.name: Plans practice-guide collection
verified_facts: The collection brings together HM Land Registry guides relating to plans.
It separately lists the basis of plans, preparing plans, boundaries, determined boundaries, title plans and other plan-related services.
semantic_limits: A collection page is used to validate source lineage and guide scope, not terrain values.

candidates.name: Get information from HM Land Registry
verified_facts: HM Land Registry identifies title registers and title plans as core property-information products.
The guidance warns that land registration is complex and errors can have significant legal and financial consequences.
semantic_limits: Information-service scope must not be interpreted as a guarantee of exact legal boundary or terrain accuracy.

candidates.name: OGC API - Coverages
verified_facts: OGC describes OGC API - Coverages as a draft specification for accessing coverages.
The page defines gridded coverages as a common coverage type and distinguishes coverage domain from encoded representation.
semantic_limits: Draft status is explicit; this source is not promoted to a final normative implementation requirement for the slot.

candidates.name: OGC API - Coverages overview
verified_facts: The draft API exposes coverage schema, coverage data and optional coverage tiles resources.
The overview shows scale-factor=1 as a request for native resolution and warns that a whole-coverage response may be downsampled where scaling is supported.
semantic_limits: Native-resolution intent and scaling parameters must be explicit; draft API examples do not prove EA service behavior or numeric correctness.

candidates.name: OGC API - Features Standard
verified_facts: OGC API Features Part 1 defines core feature access with geometries in WGS 84 longitude/latitude.
Part 2 adds support for geometries in other coordinate reference systems.
semantic_limits: A feature API response in WGS84 is not silently accepted as native EPSG:27700 parcel-measurement geometry.

candidates.name: OGC API - Features overview
verified_facts: The API exposes collections and collection metadata including spatial and temporal extents.
Features represent real-world objects described by geometry and properties.
semantic_limits: Collection extent and feature discovery metadata are not parcel-height observations.

candidates.name: OGC API - Records overview
verified_facts: Records expose metadata that makes resources such as features, coverages, tiles, maps, styles and assets discoverable.
The API exposes catalog and record resources separately from the underlying resources they describe.
semantic_limits: A record is discovery metadata and cannot be sampled as terrain data.

candidates.name: OGC API - Maps overview
verified_facts: OGC API Maps returns styled map representations and permits width, height, bbox, subset, CRS and temporal parameters.
Map output is a portrayal of underlying geospatial data.
semantic_limits: Changing map size, style, subset or CRS does not produce authoritative numeric elevation samples.

candidates.name: OGC API - Tiles overview
verified_facts: OGC API Tiles defines separate link relations and resource patterns for vector tiles, map tiles and coverage tiles.
Coverage tiles can be provided under a coverage resource while map tiles are provided under map resources.
semantic_limits: Tile transport alone is insufficient; the response must be identified as numeric coverage rather than rendered map imagery before measurement use.

candidates.name: Two Dimensional Tile Matrix Set standard page
verified_facts: TMS 2.0 defines tile matrix sets as regular grids at defined scales in a CRS.
A tile is uniquely identified by tile matrix, tile row and tile column identifiers.
semantic_limits: Tile indexing locates content but does not improve the vertical accuracy of the values inside it.

candidates.name: Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF Standard document
verified_facts: COG 1.0 is an approved OGC implementation standard.
The format combines tiled/reduced-resolution TIFF structures, GeoTIFF georeferencing and HTTP range access for efficient partial retrieval.
semantic_limits: Partial HTTP retrieval and reduced-resolution subfiles are access optimizations; they do not improve terrain accuracy.

candidates.name: Web Map Service 1.3
verified_facts: WMS provides HTTP requests for geo-registered map images from geospatial databases.
Responses are map images such as JPEG or PNG for display.
semantic_limits: WMS imagery is visual portrayal and is excluded from numeric parcel elevation sampling.

candidates.name: OGC API - Common overview
verified_facts: OGC API Common defines shared landing-page, API-definition and conformance resources.
The /conformance resource declares implemented conformance classes.
semantic_limits: Declared conformance classes establish API capability context only and do not prove parcel-value correctness.

candidates.name: OGC API - Processes
verified_facts: OGC API Processes wraps computational tasks as executable web processes.
Processes can ingest vector and/or coverage data and produce new datasets.
semantic_limits: Any server-side processing that changes source data must be explicit and reproducible; processed output is not silently treated as native raster evidence.

candidates.name: OGC API - Environmental Data Retrieval 1.1
verified_facts: OGC API EDR defines discovery and query operations for environmental data resources.
It supports standardized selection criteria for retrieving subsets from underlying data stores.
semantic_limits: EDR query semantics are not substituted for the slot's canonical EA WCS/GeoTIFF polygon-sampling method without equivalent reproducible evidence.

candidates.name: Geography Markup Language Standard
verified_facts: GML is an XML grammar for expressing geographic features and transporting/storing geographic information.
GML schemas describe the document structure while instance documents contain the actual data.
semantic_limits: GML schema validity and transport do not by themselves prove the positional truth of an HMLR parcel polygon.

candidates.name: network Common Data Form standards suite
verified_facts: OGC netCDF standards support array-oriented multidimensional geospatial data and self-describing metadata.
CF metadata describes what data represents and its spatial and temporal properties.
semantic_limits: NetCDF encoding is not the canonical EA parcel-height source and format conformance does not imply terrain accuracy.
